mapper.select: SELECT bank_user_id, name, email, password, user_token, user_key_hash, issued_at, created_at, updated_at, birth_date FROM bank_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT bank_user_id, name, email, password, user_token, user_key_hash, issued_at, created_at, updated_at, birth_date FROM bank_user WHERE user_token = #{userToken}
SELECT bank_user_id, name, user_token, user_key_hash FROM bank_user WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT bank_user_id, name, email, password, user_token, user_key_hash, issued_at, created_at, updated_at, birth_date FROM bank_user WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_user SET pending_user_key = #{pendingUserKey}, rotation_operation_id = #{operationId}, rotation_key_hash = #{pendingUserKey}, key_status = 'PENDING', pending_issued_at = #{pendingIssuedAt}, pending_expires_at = #{pendingExpiresAt} WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId} AND (key_status IS NULL OR key_status != 'PENDING' OR pending_expires_at < NOW())

UPDATE bank_user SET recovery_previous_key = user_key_hash, recovery_expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(6), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE), user_key_hash = pending_user_key, issued_at = pending_issued_at, key_status = 'ACTIVE', pending_user_key = NULL, pending_issued_at = NULL, pending_expires_at = NULL WHERE pending_user_key = #{hashedKey} AND rotation_operation_id = #{operationId} AND key_status = 'PENDING' AND pending_expires_at > NOW()

UPDATE bank_user SET key_status = 'EXPIRED', pending_user_key = NULL, pending_issued_at = NULL, pending_expires_at = NULL WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId} AND key_status = 'PENDING' AND pending_issued_at = #{pendingIssuedAt}

UPDATE bank_user SET key_status = 'EXPIRED', rotation_operation_id = NULL, rotation_key_hash = NULL, recovery_previous_key = NULL, recovery_expires_at = NULL, user_key_hash = NULL, pending_user_key = NULL, pending_issued_at = NULL, pending_expires_at = NULL WHERE user_key_hash = #{hashedKey}
mapper.select: SELECT bank_user_id, user_key_hash, pending_user_key, recovery_previous_key, recovery_expires_at, rotation_operation_id, rotation_key_hash FROM bank_user WHERE user_token = #{userToken} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_user SET recovery_previous_key = NULL, recovery_expires_at = NULL, user_key_hash = #{previousHashedKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, key_status = CASE WHEN #{previousHashedKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END, pending_user_key = NULL, pending_issued_at = NULL, pending_expires_at = NULL WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId} AND rotation_operation_id = #{operationId} AND ((user_key_hash <=> #{previousHashedKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (recovery_expires_at > NOW(6) AND (recovery_previous_key <=> #{previousHashedKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR})))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(recovery_expires_at <= NOW(6), FALSE) FROM bank_user WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId}
SELECT key_hash, previous_key_hash, issued_at, recovered FROM bank_key_operation WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId} AND operation_id = #{operationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_key_operation(bank_user_id, operation_id, key_hash, previous_key_hash, issued_at) VALUES (#{bankUserId}, #{operationId}, #{keyHash}, #{previousKeyHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{issuedAt})

INSERT INTO bank_key_operation(bank_user_id, operation_id, key_hash, previous_key_hash, recovered) VALUES (#{bankUserId}, #{operationId}, #{keyHash}, #{previousKeyHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRUE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE recovered = TRUE
